Metadata.summary: In a shock development struggling English Premier League team AFC Richmond hires American football coach Ted Lasso as its new manager. Lasso knows nothing about soccer/football. With unshakable enthusiasm and positivity he rises to the challenge but little known to him there are forces within the club that don't want him to succeed.
Metadata.title: Ted Lasso

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Funny, feel-good sports series has strong language.
